# Research Square

> > Research Square is a preprint platform for sharing early-stage research across medical and scientific disciplines, featuring clinical trials, case reports, and study protocols.

The platform hosts peer-reviewed preprints in fields including ophthalmology, anesthesiology, surgical outcomes, and clinical trial protocols. Content is primarily licensed under CC BY 4.0, with significant contributions from researchers in China and global medical institutions.

## Key Topics

- Clinical trials and randomized controlled trials
- Ophthalmology (retinal disorders, LASIK, ocular surface)
- Anesthesiology and perioperative care
- Case reports and clinical documentation
- Study protocols and trial design
- Surgical outcomes and techniques
- Video-Assisted Thoracoscopic Surgery (VATS)
- Pars plana vitrectomy (PPV)
- Airway management and lung isolation
- Anti-VEGF therapy and retinal vein occlusion
- Neurology (traumatic brain injury, Wernicke's encephalopathy)
- Pain management (lidocaine, propofol)
- Transfusion medicine
- Oncology (glioma classification)

## Clinical Trial Protocols

- [Anesthetics to Prevent Lung Injury in Cardiac Surgery (APLICS): A protocol for a randomized, controlled trial](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-28/v2): APLICS trial protocol: sevoflurane to prevent lung injury in cardiac surgery
- [Executive Function Training in Chronic Traumatic Brain Injury Patients: Study Protocol](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-273/v1): Study protocol for executive function training in chronic TBI patients
- [Targeted Interventions to Prevent Chronic Low Back Pain in High Risk Patients: Development and Delivery of a Pragmatic Training Course of Psychologically Informed Physical Therapy for the TARGET Trial](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-129/v2): TARGET trial: PIPT training course for chronic low back pain prevention
- [Effect of acupuncture on insomnia in menopausal women: A Study protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-313/v1): RCT protocol for acupuncture treatment of menopausal insomnia
- [Liberal transfusion strategy to prevent mortality and anaemia-associated, ischaemic events in elderly non-cardiac surgical patients – the study design of the LIBERAL-Trial](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-55/v1): LIBERAL trial design: transfusion strategies in elderly surgical patients

## Randomized Controlled Trials

- [Application of intravenous lidocaine in patients undergoing operative hysteroscopy: a randomized, double-blind, controlled study](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-181/v2): RCT on intravenous lidocaine for operative hysteroscopy pain relief
- [Intravitreal Dexamethasone Implants versus Intravitreal Anti-VEGF Treatment in Treating Patients with Retinal Vein Occlusion: A Meta-analysis](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-7/v3): Meta-analysis comparing dexamethasone vs anti-VEGF for RVO treatment
- [Measuring Clinical Uncertainty and Equipoise by Applying the Agreement Study Methodology to Patient Management Decisions](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-130/v2): Kappa statistics methodology for measuring clinical equipoise

## Ophthalmology Research

- [Influence of Pars Plana Vitrectomy on Ocular Surface using Non-Invasive Keratograph 5M](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-128/v1): PPV impact on ocular surface assessed with Keratograph 5M device
- [Clinical Features and Surgical Outcomes of Pediatric Ocular Trauma in Southwest of China](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-71/v1): Pediatric ocular trauma epidemiology and outcomes in southwest China
- [Factors influencing the self-reported sense of deviation in adults with successful surgical outcomes for strabismus](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-25/v2): Factors affecting perceived deviation after successful strabismus surgery
- [A Clinical Investigation about Horizontal Heterophoria Among Newly Diagnosed Myopia Juveniles in Nanchong District of China](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-272/v1): Heterophoria prevalence in myopic juveniles in Nanchong, China
- [Delayed-Onset Interface Fluid Syndrome After LASIK Following Phacotrabeculectomy](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-160/v1): First IFS case post-phacotrabeculectomy in prior LASIK patient
- [Bilateral Isolated Spherophakia with Lens Subluxation, High Myopia and Secondary Angle Closure: A Case Report](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-118/v1): Rare isolated spherophakia case with lens subluxation and myopia

## Surgical Case Reports

- [Airway Management of the Right Anterior Segmentectomy through Uniportal Video-Assisted Thoracoscopic Surgery (VATS) after Left Pneumonectomy by An Adapted Double-lumen Endobronchial Tube (DLT): A Case Report](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-138/v1): VATS segmentectomy case report on airway management post-pneumonectomy
- [Case report: use of ketamine in combination with epidural anesthesia for cesarean section in the patient with severe congenital hypothyroidism](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-243/v1): Ketamine-epidural anesthesia for C-section in hypothyroid patient
- [Wernicke's encephalopathy in a patient with severe acute pancreatitis after cholecystectomy and exploration of biliary tract](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-45/v1): Wernicke's encephalopathy case post-cholecystectomy with pancreatitis
- [High dose sildenafil citrate induced persistent binocular anomalopia: A case report](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-308/v1): Persistent vision loss case from high-dose sildenafil overdose

## Oncology and Molecular Medicine

- [A model of molecular characteristics to classify patients with WHO Grade III gliomas](https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-251/v1): Molecular classification model for WHO Grade III gliomas
